route_note: High-speed trains run frequently from Shanghai Hongqiao or Shanghai Station to Suzhou in well under an hour, with the main sights reachable by local metro or taxi from Suzhou station.
High-speed trains from Shanghai Hongqiao reach Hangzhou East in about an hour, then metro or taxi to West Lake.
Take a train or bus toward Tongxiang or Jiaxing, then a short local bus or taxi to the Wuzhen water town; direct tourist coaches also run from Shanghai.
